mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 67 degrees and a moderate air quality index of 57.

The city contracts with Pellitteri Waste Systems for residential refuse and recycling, and residents are encouraged to use the Waste Wizard tool on the city website to determine the proper disposal method for specific items.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, and several trivia nights scheduled for Tuesday at local venues like Hop Haus and Paddy Mac's.

In a notable incident from the weekly report, officers arrested a man on October 25th for an O W I after finding him unresponsive in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, and since the store is currently open until 10:00 PM, you have plenty of time to stop in for a treat.
